description: This course is an advanced course on graph theory. It covers the following topics: tournaments and generalizations, perfect graphs, Ramsey theory, extremal graphs, matroids. The course is for mathematics graduate students with interest in graph theory and its applications.
prerequisite: If undertaking an Undergraduate Degree THEN ( must have completed MA4235 at a grade of at least D)
prerequisiteRule: PROGRAM_TYPES IF_IN Undergraduate Degree THEN (COURSES (1) MA4235:D)
title: Advanced Graph Theory
